---
title: "When to Use #!/bin/sh vs #!/usr/bin/env bash"
---

# When to Use #!/bin/sh vs #!/usr/bin/env bash

* `#!/usr/bin/env bash`: Best for scripts relying on Bash features (finds bash in PATH across Linux, macOS, FreeBSD).
* `#!/bin/sh`: Best for minimal, ultra-portable scripts that execute under Debian Dash or Alpine Busybox Ash.
